name: Cairo
industries: Mega-project construction, banking, telecoms and a growing software offshoring sector anchor Cairo's project economy.
intro:
Cairo sits at the centre of the Arab world's largest construction and transformation programme: the New Administrative Capital, monorail lines, and a national digitisation drive that has made Egypt a serious offshoring destination for Gulf and European clients. The city's engineering and consulting firms staff mega-projects at home and export project talent across the Gulf — where Egyptian professionals with international certification command regional salaries. PMP is the recognised standard across construction, energy and government programmes; Scrum credentials grow with Smart Village's software exporters. Batches are scheduled live online across the whole year at hours built for Cairo: a weekend Sat–Sun cohort and a weekday Wed–Thu cohort each week, all landing in comfortable local daytime; every upcoming date and its exact Cairo timing is listed in the schedule below. Afterwards you get careful exam application support, mock exams at real difficulty, and open trainer access until you pass.

Cairo combines mega-project scale with a services export boom: the national infrastructure and new-capital programs run classical stage-gated delivery, while global capability centres in Smart Village and New Cairo hire delivery leads for international clients in multiple languages. Certification serves both — governance legibility for the mega-projects, client-facing credibility for the centres. Training is live online across two consecutive days with session times shown for Cairo on this page. Egyptian salaries for certified project roles vary widely between domestic and export-facing employers; the sourced entries below give dated figures for each. The employer list reflects that construction-plus-GCC mix, and capability centres scaling delivery teams can certify cohorts together on their own calendar.

faq.q: What are the class timings in Cairo?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM UK, which is 11:00 AM – 08:00 PM GMT+3 in Cairo. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.q: Is the training online or at a venue in Cairo?
faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Cairo. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from Egypt?
faq.a: No. The certification is issued by the same global body regardless of where you attend from, and holds identical recognition with employers in Egypt and internationally.

faq.q: Can my employer in Cairo sponsor the course?
faq.a: Yes. We issue invoices suitable for corporate sponsorship and reimbursement, and most employers in Egypt accept them under learning and development budgets. Group pricing is available for teams.

faq.q: How much does {course} training cost in Cairo?
faq.a: The fee for the live online {course} course for Cairo is shown at the top of this page in EGP and covers the complete two-day program. No extra charges appear at checkout — the displayed fee is the whole training cost.

faq.q: Should I pick the weekday or weekend {course} batch in Cairo?
faq.a: They are the same {course} course on different days. If your Cairo role has hard weekday commitments, take Sat–Sun; otherwise Wed–Thu gets you certified mid-week. Check the table above for Cairo local times.

faq.q: Can I take the {course} exam from Cairo?
faq.a: Yes — the {course} exam can be taken online from Cairo; you do not need to travel. The exam and certification guide further up this page explains the exact format, attempts and booking process.

faq.q: Is {course} certification recognized by employers in Cairo?
faq.a: Yes. The {course} credential is issued by its global certifying body and is the one most commonly named in relevant Cairo job descriptions. The employer list on this page shows where certified professionals in Cairo work.

faq.q: What salary can a {course}-certified professional expect in Cairo?
faq.a: See the salary table on this page — every Cairo figure carries a named source and an as-of date, so you can verify it rather than trust a marketing average. Certified professionals typically use these sourced numbers in appraisal and offer negotiations.

faq.q: How soon can I start {course} training in Cairo?
faq.a: The batch table above lists the next start dates for Cairo — two cohorts run every week (weekday and weekend), so you are never more than a few days from a {course} start.

faq.q: Do you offer group pricing for {course} training for teams in Cairo?
faq.a: Yes. Teams in Cairo can enroll together under group pricing, and larger groups can run a private {course} cohort scheduled to their own calendar — use the enquiry option on this page with your team size.

faq.q: What language is the {course} training in Cairo delivered in?
faq.a: All live {course} sessions are delivered in English, the working language of certification exams and of most project teams in Cairo. Trainers take questions throughout the live sessions.

faq.q: How do I enroll in the {course} course from Cairo?
faq.a: Pick a batch from the table above and use its Enroll button — you'll get a confirmation by email. The full flow is online; nothing requires visiting an office in Cairo.

faq.q: Where can I see the {course} exam fee for Egypt?
faq.a: The exam-cost section on this page lists the current {course} exam fee for Egypt with a link to the certifying body's official fee page, so the number you plan around is the official one.

faq.q: Why choose live online {course} training over a self-paced course in Cairo?
faq.a: A recorded course leaves you alone with the material. Live {course} training gets Cairo professionals trainer feedback on real scenarios and a fixed two-day finish line.
